reading_note: The teaching describes the five structural works by which the operative Divine power (the Living Spirit) restrains and orders the dominant self-loves (the strong archons), binding them into a fixed cosmic order. The arc moves from the highest support (the celestial disc borne on the shoulder of the world-bearer) down through the central axis of ascent, into the molding of the hells, then to the pillars set in the lowest natural sea, and finally outward to the four walls enclosing the fortified loves. Five discrete degrees of containment correspond to five faculties of reception — celestial, spiritual, rational, natural, sensual — by which divine order holds infernal forces in their place so the whole may serve use.
